title: drynaria normalis
intro: Drynaria normalis, commonly known as the Chinese club moss or black gold, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and inflammation. The health benefits of Drynaria normalis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, polysaccharides, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects.
